title: Mode 7 Engine
subtitle: Browser-based racing renderer
description: A JavaScript racing engine inspired by the perspective and systems of classic Mode 7 games.

components.heading: Mode 7 Engine
paragraphs: Mode 7 Engine rebuilds the feel of a classic sprite-based kart racer in the browser. The project combines a perspective road renderer with track data, sprite animation, player control, AI racers, items, collision, particles, menus, and race-state management.

Rather than treating the road as a static effect, the renderer became the foundation for a larger playable system. Camera behavior, map sampling, sprite scale, and object placement all respond to the same simulated space.
The project is an ongoing technical study in how a recognizable visual language can be reconstructed with modern browser tools.
